entries.text: This lockfile change matches my dependencies→devDependencies move from commit 1, but something auto-rewrote it after the fact, so it now needs to land separately since commit 1 is already made. I want to verify the lockfile stays consistent with a frozen-lockfile install check before deciding whether to fold it in or commit it on its own.
It's the lockfile catching up with commit 1's move of every dependency into `devDependencies`. Checking that it's consistent, then folding it into that commit, since nothing is pushed.
